title: Annotatio III §.IV open: From non-cause to VERA ORTUS CAUSA — Idololatria & Tyrannis of Papism
pass_a_gloss: §. IV. But from the non-cause of Transsubstantiation’s origin one must come down to the TRUE CAUSE OF ITS ORTUS, located in Idolatry and Tyranny — the true soul of Papism and things about to win for it the highest disgrace of Antichristianism.
pass_b_english: §.IV: leave the non-cause; the TRUE CAUSE of Transsubstantiation’s Ortus sits in Idolatry and Tyranny.
That pair is Papism’s true soul, and will win it Antichristianism’s highest disgrace.
source_text: §. IV. Cæterùm à Causa non causa oriundæ Transsubstantiationis ad VERAM ORTUS EJUS CAUSAM deveniendum est, in Idololatria & Tyrannide, Papismi vera anima huicque summum Antichristianismi dedecus conciliaturis, locatam.

lemmas.gloss: the true cause of its origin

choices.english: non-cause / cause that is no cause
rejected: cause non-cause as a legal brief
